name: Belgium
description: Brussels Grand Place guildhouses and town hall, Antwerp Cathedral of Our Lady, Bruges stepped-gable canal houses, Atomium in distance. Belgian flag: three equal VERTICAL bands BLACK, YELLOW, RED left to right. Local foods on a small tasteful foreground cafe table at lower left edge: Belgian waffle, paper cone of fries, fine praline chocolates. Keep the food grouping secondary, beautifully painted, no packaging labels.

name: The Netherlands
description: Amsterdam canal houses with arched bridge and bicycles; a traditional Dutch windmill along water, Rotterdam Erasmus Bridge in distance. Dutch flag: three equal HORIZONTAL bands RED, WHITE, BLUE top to bottom. Foods on small foreground cafe table: stroopwafels, wedges of Gouda cheese, small plate of bitterballen. Secondary food still life, no labels.

name: United Kingdom
description: London Elizabeth Tower and Palace of Westminster, Tower Bridge, Edinburgh Castle on a distant rise. Correct Union Jack on a modest flagpole with blue ground and white/red crosses and offset diagonals. Foods on small foreground cafe table: fish and chips, scones with clotted cream and jam, a cup of tea. Secondary food still life, no labels.

name: France
description: Paris Eiffel Tower, Arc de Triomphe, Notre Dame cathedral with two west towers and its central spire; elegant Seine embankment foreground. French flag: three equal VERTICAL bands BLUE, WHITE, RED left to right. Foods on foreground cafe table: croissant, baguette, small selection of French cheeses. Secondary food still life, no labels.

name: Germany
description: Berlin Brandenburg Gate, Munich Frauenkirche twin domed towers, Neuschwanstein Castle in a misty distant hill. German flag: three equal HORIZONTAL bands BLACK, RED, GOLD top to bottom. Foods on small foreground table: pretzel, bratwurst in bread, slice of Black Forest cake. Secondary food still life, no labels.

name: Italy
description: Rome Colosseum, Florence cathedral's terracotta dome, Leaning Tower of Pisa, a little Venetian canal frontage combining into an Italian panorama. Italian flag: three equal VERTICAL bands GREEN, WHITE, RED left to right. Foods on small foreground table: Margherita pizza, bowl of pasta, gelato in cup. Secondary food still life, no labels.

name: Spain
description: Barcelona Sagrada Familia, Madrid Royal Palace, Alhambra towers in distant landscaped hill, warm Spanish plaza. Spanish flag: HORIZONTAL RED-YELLOW-RED, middle yellow band twice the height of each red band, small authentic coat of arms toward hoist. Foods on small foreground table: pan of paella, churros with chocolate, small tapas dishes. Secondary food still life, no labels.

name: Portugal
description: Lisbon Belem Tower and Monument to the Discoveries, Porto Dom Luis I bridge across Douro-inspired waterfront, tiled riverside houses. Portuguese flag: VERTICAL GREEN 2/5 at hoist, RED 3/5 at fly, small coat of arms on armillary sphere at border. Foods on small foreground cafe table: pasteis de nata custard tarts, grilled sardines, bowl of caldo verde. Secondary food still life, no labels.

name: India
description: Taj Mahal with central white dome and four minarets as dominant distant focus, Delhi India Gate, Mumbai Gateway of India, layered Indian urban riverfront. Indian flag: three equal HORIZONTAL bands SAFFRON, WHITE, GREEN, navy blue 24-spoke Ashoka Chakra centered on white. Foods on small foreground table: samosas, thali with small curry bowls and rice, naan and cup of chai. Secondary food still life, no labels.

name: USA
description: New York Statue of Liberty and Empire State skyline, San Francisco Golden Gate Bridge, US Capitol dome in a distant composed vista. Correct United States flag with 13 alternating red and white horizontal stripes, blue canton at upper hoist containing small white stars. Foods on small foreground table: hamburger, apple pie slice, barbecue corn on cob. Secondary food still life, no labels.

name: Brazil
description: Rio Christ the Redeemer statue on Corcovado above Sugarloaf Mountain and bay, colorful Selaron-style steps in foreground and Sao Paulo skyline in distance. Brazilian flag green field, yellow rhombus, blue globe with white curved band and small white stars; depict emblem faithfully at plausible small scale, no enlarged lettering. Foods on small foreground table: feijoada with rice and orange slices, pao de queijo, brigadeiros. Secondary food still life, no labels.

name: China
description: Beijing Temple of Heaven round tiered blue roofs, Forbidden City imperial gate and guardian lions, Great Wall running over distant hills, Shanghai Oriental Pearl in far skyline. Correct Chinese flag: RED field, one large YELLOW star near upper hoist with four smaller yellow stars curving to its right. Foods on small foreground table: bamboo steamer of dumplings, roast duck pancakes, bowl of noodles. Secondary food still life, no labels.

name: Japan
description: Kyoto Toji five-story pagoda, Fushimi Inari vermilion torii walkway, Tokyo Tower and modern skyline distant, Fuji mountain in mist. Japanese flag white rectangular field with centered RED circular disc. Foods on small foreground table: sushi assortment, bowl of ramen, matcha tea and mochi. Secondary food still life, no labels.

name: Thailand
description: Bangkok Wat Arun central prang and Grand Palace gilded roofs, Chiang Mai Doi Suthep temple in distant mountain, lush riverfront. Thai flag five HORIZONTAL bands RED, WHITE, BLUE, WHITE, RED; central blue band twice the height of each other band. Foods on small foreground table: pad thai, tom yum soup, mango sticky rice. Secondary food still life, no labels.

name: Czech Republic
description: Harmonious national panorama combining Prague Charles Bridge and Prague Castle with Saint Vitus Cathedral, Cesky Krumlov castle tower and red-roof old town, Karlstejn Castle on a distant forested hill. Czech flag on modest left flagpole: WHITE upper half, RED lower half, BLUE triangle at hoist reaching halfway across the flag. Small foreground cafe food arrangement: svickova beef with cream sauce and sliced bread dumplings, round kolace pastries, golden bramboraky potato pancakes. Foods secondary, authentic natural flag/food colors, no labels.

name: Brussels
description: Grand Place town hall and richly detailed guildhouses dominate; recognizable small Manneken Pis bronze fountain statue in the foreground, Atomium distant. No country flag or food still life needed.

name: Antwerp
description: Cathedral of Our Lady spire, Grote Markt guildhouses, Brabo fountain statue as recognizable bronze foreground landmark, Antwerp Centraal station dome in midground.

name: Bruges
description: Belfry above Markt, stepped-gable houses and Rozenhoedkaai canal bridge, Jan Breydel and Pieter de Coninck bronze double statue as a smaller sculptural landmark.

name: Amsterdam
description: Distinctive narrow canal houses, Westerkerk tower and Magere Brug; Rembrandt statue on a pedestal near the canal-side foreground, subtle bicycles.

name: Rotterdam
description: Erasmus Bridge and angular Cube Houses beside river; recognizable dark bronze The Destroyed City sculpture with raised arms as a foreground landmark, modern skyline.

name: London
description: Elizabeth Tower and Houses of Parliament along Thames, Tower Bridge; Nelson's Column with sculpted lions incorporated into foreground plaza montage, authentic proportions.

name: Edinburgh
description: Edinburgh Castle on Castle Rock, Royal Mile stone buildings, Scott Monument gothic canopy with its seated Walter Scott statue discernible; Arthur's Seat distant.

name: Paris
description: Eiffel Tower, Notre Dame west facade and Arc de Triomphe in distant vista along Seine; small gilded equestrian Joan of Arc statue in foreground plaza.

name: Lyon
description: Fourviere basilica on the hill, Vieux Lyon riverside architecture and Saone bridge, bronze equestrian Louis XIV statue in a foreground plaza inspired by Place Bellecour.

name: Berlin
description: Brandenburg Gate, Reichstag dome and Fernsehturm skyline; Berlin Victory Column crowned by gilded winged Victoria as sculptural landmark. No flags, no food required.

name: Munich
description: Marienplatz New Town Hall and Frauenkirche twin onion domes, Bavaria bronze statue on pedestal as a smaller foreground sculptural landmark, Bavarian streets.

name: Rome
description: Colosseum, Roman Forum columns and distant St Peter's dome; equestrian Marcus Aurelius statue on pedestal, ancient Roman cobbles.

name: Milan
description: Milan Cathedral highly detailed gothic facade and spires, Galleria Vittorio Emanuele entrance; Leonardo da Vinci statue on its sculpted pedestal as foreground landmark.

name: Madrid
description: Royal Palace and Puerta de Alcala, recognizable Bear and Strawberry Tree bronze statue as foreground sculptural landmark, elegant plaza.

name: Barcelona
description: Sagrada Familia with distinctive tapered spires, Casa Batllo facade and Park Guell mosaic dragon fountain in foreground; Mediterranean city backdrop.

name: Lisbon
description: Belem Tower, Jeronimos Monastery and Tagus river; Monument to the Discoveries prow with carved explorers as sculptural landmark, tiled pavement.

name: Porto
description: Dom Luis I bridge over Douro, Ribeira colorful houses and Clerigos tower; equestrian Dom Pedro IV statue on a smaller foreground pedestal.

name: New Delhi
description: India Gate, red sandstone Red Fort gate and Humayun's Tomb dome; seated Mahatma Gandhi statue as a serene smaller foreground landmark.

name: Mumbai
description: Gateway of India and Taj Mahal Palace hotel with central red dome, Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj Terminus gothic architecture in midground; equestrian Shivaji statue as a secondary foreground landmark.

name: New York
description: Statue of Liberty prominently recognizable on left across harbor, Empire State Building, Chrysler Building and Brooklyn Bridge. Liberty is the main landmark statue, do not duplicate her.

name: San Francisco
description: Golden Gate Bridge, Palace of Fine Arts rotunda and steep Victorian streets; Cupid's Span large bow-and-arrow public sculpture as secondary waterfront landmark, subtle bay mist.

name: Rio de Janeiro
description: Christ the Redeemer statue on Corcovado as skyline focus, Sugarloaf Mountain and Guanabara Bay, colorful Selaron steps foreground and coastal buildings. Do not duplicate the Redeemer.

name: Sao Paulo
description: MASP glass museum with red structural beams, Sao Paulo Cathedral twin spires and Paulista skyline; Monument to the Bandeiras stone sculptural group as secondary foreground landmark.

name: Beijing
description: Temple of Heaven's round triple blue roof, Forbidden City's imperial architecture and a distant Great Wall ridge; finely carved bronze guardian lion statues in foreground, no political portraits.

name: Shanghai
description: Oriental Pearl Tower, Shanghai Tower and Bund historic waterfront buildings on Huangpu River; Bund Bull bronze statue as secondary foreground sculptural landmark.

name: Tokyo
description: Tokyo Tower and Sensoji temple with pagoda, Shibuya modern skyline in distance; small recognizable bronze Hachiko dog statue on pedestal foreground.

name: Kyoto
description: Toji five-story pagoda, Fushimi Inari torii gates and Kiyomizu-dera wooden terrace; carved stone kitsune fox guardian statues at foreground shrine entrance, greenery.

name: Bangkok
description: Wat Arun central prang across Chao Phraya, Grand Palace and Wat Phra Kaew layered golden rooflines; ornate yaksha guardian statues as secondary foreground landmark sculptures.

name: Chiang Mai
description: Doi Suthep gilded chedi on a distant green hillside, Wat Chedi Luang brick stupa and old city walls; Three Kings Monument bronze trio as secondary foreground sculptural landmark.

name: Gent
description: Ghent's Graslei and Korenlei guildhouses lining the river, the three medieval towers (Saint Nicholas Church, Belfry, Saint Bavo Cathedral) in the skyline, Gravensteen castle. Jacob van Artevelde bronze statue on its pedestal as a smaller foreground landmark. Recognizable Flemish architecture; compose one art-directed riverfront vista.

name: Los Angeles
description: Griffith Observatory with its three domes set on a distant sunlit hill, palm-lined Los Angeles downtown skyline, Walt Disney Concert Hall's swooping stainless steel architecture. A compact group of the recognizable Urban Light historic street-lamp sculpture in the foreground as public-art landmark. Southern Californian planting and a handsome plaza; no invented canal, no Hollywood lettering, no readable signage.

name: Utrecht
description: Utrecht Dom Tower in recognizable tall gothic form, Dom Church, the distinctive Oudegracht canal with low wharf-level cellars and brick bridges, Dutch townhouses. Bronze Jan van Nassau standing statue with document, on pedestal, as secondary foreground landmark. No windmills imported from another city.

name: Chennai
description: Chennai Central railway station's red-and-cream Indo-Saracenic facade and clocktower, Kapaleeshwarar Temple's richly carved colorful gopuram, Marina Beach promenade beside Bay of Bengal. Triumph of Labour bronze group of four workers pushing a rock as secondary foreground sculpture. Warm coastal plants, Indian architecture, no European canal or gothic imported buildings.

name: Frankfurt
description: Romerberg stepped-gable half-timbered town hall, Frankfurt Cathedral's red sandstone gothic tower, Main river and Eiserner Steg bridge, recognizable Main Tower and modern banking skyline. Justice Fountain with bronze female Justitia holding scales and sword on a slender column as foreground sculptural landmark.

name: Düsseldorf
description: Rhine embankment, Burgplatz Schlossturm with its distinctive round tower and roof, twisted Gehry buildings in MedienHafen, slender Rheinturm skyline. Bronze equestrian Jan Wellem statue on a stone pedestal as foreground sculptural landmark.

name: Bordeaux
description: Place de la Bourse elegant symmetrical classical facades reflected in the shallow Miroir d'eau, Pont de Pierre over Garonne and Saint Andre cathedral towers in distance. Monument aux Girondins fountain with bronze rearing horses and its tall column crowned by Liberty as secondary sculptural landmark. French limestone architecture, no Eiffel Tower.

name: Naples
description: Naples waterfront with Castel dell'Ovo, Piazza del Plebiscito's San Francesco di Paola dome and colonnade, Mount Vesuvius across the bay. Fontana del Gigante with its three decorated arches and sculpted figures as secondary foreground landmark. Mediterranean waterfront, warm Neapolitan facades, no Roman Colosseum.

name: Prague
description: Charles Bridge with Old Town Bridge Tower spanning Vltava, Prague Castle and Saint Vitus Cathedral on hill, Old Town Hall's Astronomical Clock tower in art-directed midground. Bronze Saint John of Nepomuk statue with halo of five stars on Charles Bridge balustrade as foreground sculptural landmark. Historic red tile roofs, gothic stone and warm baroque facades.
